description: Returns the SVG source of one free map (blank world, blank US states, blank US counties, blank maps of countries and continents, labelled Switzerland cantons) with its region names. Every region is one <path> with id and data-name, ready to recolour as a choropleth. Free for any use. Pass id from list_maps or find_map (e.g. "free-blank-japan-map-svg"), or a place name ("Japan").

force.description: return the SVG even when it is larger than 400 KB (US counties is about 1 MB)

include_svg.description: false = only metadata, region names and download URL

name: get_free_map
title: Get a free SVG map
